pages.text: Two spells play a short cinematic for the caster: the $(l)Barrier Breaker$() (about 30 s) and the $(l)Black Hole$() (about 8 s). While one plays, your movement and mouse are locked so the camera cannot be dragged.
pages.title: Cutscenes

pages.text: Press $(l)K$() or $(l)Esc$() to skip at any time. Skipping only ends the camera: the spell still happens exactly the same for everyone.
